The user wants me to provide a corrected SystemVerilog implementation of the axis_async_fifo module based on the original code and the test results. The original code had issues with the FIFO implementation using a single count register with combinational read/write address calculations, which caused timing issues leading to data loss and corruption in test cases.

I need to implement a proper dual-pointer FIFO (write pointer and read pointer with an extra MSB for full/empty detection) with registered outputs and proper memory access timing. The implementation should be in SystemVerilog with proper syntax.

Let me write a complete, corrected SystemVerilog module.
